title: csharp-indexer deployment diagram
description: How csharp-indexer runs on a developer's machine: one self-contained executable, a shared daemon per user that daemon queries for terse C# views and structure, a short-lived hook per tool call, and a stdio server for debugging. Nothing runs anywhere else.

sources.symbol: Build the C# indexer for both CPU types

nodes.name: Developer's machine
nodes.description: macOS (arm64 or x64) or Linux (x64 or arm64); the release builds these four. Everything below runs here as the same user.

nodes.name: Coding agent's client (for example Claude Code)
nodes.description: Starts zazzle daemon mcp as the stdio MCP server per session where init found daemon, and runs csharp-indexer hook before Bash, Grep, Glob and Read calls once init has configured the project. It does not start the indexer itself.

nodes.name: Developer's terminal
nodes.description: Runs csharp-indexer init in a project and csharp-indexer report.

nodes.name: csharp-indexer serve
nodes.description: Started by hand for debugging: pipes standard input and output to the daemon, or serves in process with --no-daemon, ZAZZLE_INDEXER_NO_DAEMON=1 or when no daemon can be used. It lists no tools.

nodes.name: csharp-indexer daemon
nodes.description: One per state directory (per user by default), started detached by the first daemon (or serve) that finds none, holding the engine, watchers and indexes; serves every client of daemon.sock and exits after the idle period.

nodes.name: daemon (src/macos/daemon/)
nodes.description: zazzle's daemon, another tool in this repository and the agents' only front door. init registers zazzle daemon mcp as the project's zazzle MCP server when it finds the daemon beside the indexer in libexec/zazzle. For zazzle read of a .cs file and for zazzle's structure tools, the daemon connects to daemon.sock, starting the indexer daemon if nothing answers, sends the hello line and calls view, overview, find_symbol, changed_since, git_log, git_blame or report_gap by name over MCP.

nodes.name: csharp-indexer hook
nodes.description: One short-lived process per Bash, Grep, Glob or Read call; decides by exit code and appends to the usage log.
nodes.condition: In projects where csharp-indexer init has run

nodes.name: csharp-indexer init and report
nodes.description: One-shot commands: init writes the project's .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json, naming the daemon it finds and the hook; report reads the usage log.

nodes.name: State directory
nodes.description: store.db (SQLite, WAL), usage.jsonl and usage.jsonl.1 and daemon.sock, in ~/Library/Application Support/csharp-indexer, $XDG_STATE_HOME/csharp-indexer or ZAZZLE_INDEXER_STATE_DIR.

nodes.name: git
nodes.description: Child processes for work-tree checks, listings, ignore checks, log and blame; must be on PATH.

nodes.name: Git work trees (the roots)
nodes.description: The source files the index reads and watches. csharp-indexer never writes them.

artifacts.name: csharp-indexer (single-file executable)
artifacts.description: dotnet publish src -c Release -r <rid>: self-contained, single file, ReadyToRun, native libraries included, not Developer ID signed. For macOS it is gzipped per CPU type into the release tarball and the zazzle Homebrew formula expands the matching one on install; for Linux it is in zazzle-linux-<arch>.tar.gz (delivery.json).
